title: fix(app-shell): the command palette closes after a command that does not navigate (objectui#12683)
body:
Fixes #12683
Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

The ⌘K palette runs every command through `runCommand`, which calls `setOpen(false)` and then the command. `runCommand` was a `useCallback` with an empty dependency list. So it kept the palette's first-render `setOpen`. That `setOpen` (from `useUrlOverlay`) returns early when `next === isOpen(searchParams)`, using the `searchParams` of the render it was made in. The defect had two faces, and both were measured in a browser on `main` before the fix:

- **Opened after the page loaded** (header Search button, ⌘K). The first render's URL had no `?palette=1`, so the stale `setOpen(false)` read the palette as already closed and did nothing. Dark / Light Theme applied the theme and left the palette open. A navigating command only seemed to close it, because the navigation replaced the URL. Back then reopened the palette.
- **Opened by the `?palette=1` deep link.** The stale `setOpen(false)` did act, but through that render's `setSearchParams`/`navigate`. Those resolve `?…` against the pathname of that render. So after a navigating command, a theme command run from the next page took the user back to the deep-linked page.

## The fix

`runCommand` is now a plain function, so it calls the current render's `setOpen`. Every caller is an inline `onSelect`/`onOpen` arrow that is rebuilt on each render, so the memo bought nothing, and its dependency list was the part that went stale. `useUrlOverlay` is unchanged. Nothing on the package entry changes: no export, prop or type.

## Measured before editing (seat hypotheses)

**H0, reproduce on unchanged `main` (browser).** The backend was objectstack `66d456d01` (`/home/user/verify-os-12643`, `examples/app-showcase`, `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`), used only as a backend. The console was this branch's own worktree at `b275f58` (vite dev, workspace `src` aliases). `CommandPalette.tsx`, `useUrlOverlay.ts` and `CommandPaletteProvider.tsx` are byte-identical between the claim-time `main` `260ef71` and `b275f58`. Driven with Playwright and Chromium, signed in as `admin@objectos.ai`, starting on `/apps/showcase_app/page/showcase_capability_map`:

| step | `main` `b275f58` | this branch |
|---|---|---|
| header Search, type `dark`, click **Dark Theme**: sampled 6 times over 2.1 s | `html` flips `light`→`dark`; dialog `overlay:command-palette` **stays mounted**; URL **keeps `?palette=1`** in all 6 samples | `html` flips to `dark`; dialog **unmounted**; URL **without `?palette=1`** in all 6 samples; `history.length` unchanged |
| control: Escape (the dialog's own `onOpenChange`) | closes | (not needed) |
| reopen, type `accounts`, click the `Accounts` object entry | lands on `/apps/showcase_app/showcase_account`, dialog unmounted, **+1** history entry | same: lands on the route, dialog unmounted, **+1** history entry |
| then browser **Back** | `…/showcase_capability_map?palette=1`, **palette reopened** | `…/showcase_capability_map`, palette **closed** |
| deep link `…/showcase_capability_map?palette=1` → `Accounts` → reopen on Accounts → **Light Theme** | URL becomes **`/apps/showcase_app/page/showcase_capability_map`**: the user is taken off Accounts | URL stays **`/apps/showcase_app/showcase_account`**, palette closed |

**H1: is the root the palette's empty dependency list alone, or the hook's callback too?** I measured it once through the real `useUrlOverlay` under a `MemoryRouter`, with a scratch test that I deleted afterwards and did not commit. I captured `setOpen` while the overlay was closed, then opened it with `openOverlay()`: the URL became `?palette=1`, and `setOpen`'s identity changed. Calling the **captured** `setOpen(false)` then left it open with `?palette=1` (a no-op). Calling the **current** `setOpen(false)` closed it, with the search empty. ⇒ The hook's early return reads its captured `searchParams`, so it bites only a caller that holds a stale identity. That makes the palette's empty list the root.

**Other `useUrlOverlay` callers, measured by reading each call site:** none holds a stale identity, so the hook keeps its shape and the seat's conditional preference for the `useUrlOverlay` fix does not apply.
- `CommandPaletteProvider`: its context value is a `useMemo` whose dependencies list `open`, `openOverlay`, `closeOverlay`, `toggleOverlay` and `setOpen`. Its ⌘K `keydown` effect depends on `[toggleOverlay]`.
- `KeyboardShortcutsDialog`: binds `onOpenChange={setOpen}` on each render. Its `?` `keydown` effect depends on `[toggleOverlay]`.
- `AppHeader`: binds `onClick={openShortcuts}` and `onClick={openCommandPalette}` on each render.
- `CommandPalette` itself: `onOpenChange={setOpen}` on each render (the Escape control above). `runCommand` was the only capture.

**History (seat shape 3).** In both trees the navigating command adds exactly one entry, the route's, and the theme command adds none. Opening uses `replace`, and closing uses `replace`. `?palette=1` is never pushed as an extra entry. One reading **differs from today**, and I am surfacing it rather than calling it unchanged. On `main`, Back after a navigating command reopened the palette, because the entry left behind still carried `?palette=1`. On this branch, `runCommand` closes the palette (replacing that entry) before it navigates, so Back returns to the page with the palette closed. That is the state the page was in before the palette opened, and it is what `runCommand`'s close-then-run order was written to do.

## Pins (`CommandPalette.closesOnCommand-12683.test.tsx`)

Each test goes through the real `CommandPalette`, `CommandPaletteProvider` (and so the real `useUrlOverlay`) and `ThemeProvider`, in a `MemoryRouter` whose first entry is a sentinel, so Back counts the entries a command adds:

1. A non-navigating command (Dark Theme) closes a palette opened by **the header button**, and also one opened by **the ⌘K accelerator** (two cases). The theme applies, the dialog unmounts, the URL has no `?palette=1`, and Back reaches the sentinel.
2. A navigating command lands on its route with the palette closed. Back returns to the page with the palette closed, and a second Back reaches the sentinel: exactly one entry was added.
3. In a palette opened by the deep link, a later theme command run from another page stays on that page.

**Before (exact `main` code) and after, plus the ablation.** The ablation is a revert of the fix, run through `ablation-replace.mjs` in two nested anchored replacements (the import, then the `runCommand` body). It put `CommandPalette.tsx` back to `main`'s exact blob `42e1f46` (asserted on disk during the run), and restored to the `HEAD` blob `84afbfc` with `git diff HEAD` empty:

| pin | `main` code (`42e1f46`) | this branch (`3b6acaa`) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 · header button | red: `expect(paletteMounted()).toBe(false)` after the theme applied (`true`) | green |
| 1 · ⌘K | red: same assertion | green |
| 2 · navigating | red: after Back, `where()` is `{ path: …/showcase_capability_map, search: '?palette=1' }`, not `search: ''` | green |
| 3 · deep link | red: after Dark Theme, `where().path` is `…/page/showcase_capability_map`, not `…/showcase_account` | green |

There was also a second, independent mutation on `ec89013`: `runCommand` held in a `useState` initializer, so it kept the first render's closure as the old memo did. It turned the same 4 tests red at the same assertions. On disk: anchor 1→0, replacement 0→1, blob changed. It was restored to `HEAD`. `main`'s eslint had already flagged the line: `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` warned "React Hook useCallback has a missing dependency: 'setOpen'". The warning is gone on this branch (13 → 12 warnings on `CommandPalette.tsx`, 0 errors on both).

## Local gates (hand-derived per the dispatch; the full CI suite runs in CI), all on `3b6acaa`

- Closure build `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter "@object-ui/app-shell^..." run build` → exit 0.
- `pnpm exec vitest run` (repo-root form) over every test file that names `CommandPalette` or `useUrlOverlay`, plus the new pin: 40 files → `Test Files 40 passed (40)`, `Tests 356 passed (356)`, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) → exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` reads the new pin.
- `eslint` on the changed `.tsx` files → exit 0, 0 errors.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` → exit 0 (1 changeset declared for 1 released package).
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations` → `0 new citation(s)`, exit 0.

## Acceptance notes (observations, not filed)

- `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` runs at `warn`. This stale closure shipped with its warning showing in `main`'s lint output. Raising the rule's severity is a gate change, so it is not proposed here. Carrier: none.
- `useUrlOverlay` is a published export of `@object-ui/app-shell`. Its `setOpen` / `openOverlay` / `closeOverlay` close over the render's `searchParams` and router state, so a consumer that captures one stale meets this same failure. No in-tree consumer does (measured above), and no outside consumer is named. So the hook is left as it is, and this note has no carrier.
